description: MyGate one-hour Surprise Delivery widget. Adds secure DNS fallback for ack.mygate.in only if the device cannot resolve it. One request per tap.

patches.name: One-Tap Surprise Delivery (1 Hour)
patches.description: Turns MyGate Security widget into a one-tap, one-hour Surprise Delivery pre-approval. Uses MyGate's existing login.

release_notes: Adds a targeted fallback when Android cannot resolve ack.mygate.in. Resolves normally first; only on UnknownHostException for this hostname tries its two verified HTTPS edge IPs. TLS hostname verification is unchanged. No additional DNS service or relay. Each tap remains a separate MyGate pre-approval request (rapid taps queued). **Runtime behavior on the user device remains unverified.**
repoDescription: Unofficial MyGate 7.31.0 one-tap Surprise Delivery Morphe patch source
